The complete PDF SHA-256 is <code>731d491f5c1f4ff40074468dfb98169d63333d9afd59ecde69e9da8e3f936878</code>; its captured payload matches CDX base32 SHA-1 <code>CHZ3KRAUQRKEPI7KG4MXRFAS4NMSTNYA</code>. The PDF is readable, unrepaired, three pages and has intact EOF. The whole page-2 raster and full PDF are preserved; no missing upper face was reconstructed.

The actual older game text says “forfeit = 0”; the later full and partial faces say “forfeit for 0”. This older partial prints a dotted bottom label and no errata mark. Printed marks and image-version codes are recorded independently. The existing current full face retains <code>207_3</code>; no new historical executable ID is asserted.
